title: Introduce stratified semantic baseline comparator and CI comparator hook
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Add a stratified semantic baseline comparator and a lightweight CI hook that computes per-stratum delta with adaptive slack scaling. Motivation: existing regression gates operate on coarse aggregates and miss regressions that are localized to semantic strata (e.g., intent clusters and domain slices). This PR introduces a semantic clustering step, an importance-weighted delta comparator, and a CI hook that can be configured to quarantine prompt-sets that exceed stratified thresholds. The implementation is intended to be low-latency and safe to run on CI workers. Key behaviors: (1) builds semantic clusters using an ensemble embedding/UMAP downsample strategy, (2) computes per-cluster baseline distributions and a weighted composite delta, (3) applies a progressive quarantine policy that escalates from WARN -> QUARANTINE -> FAIL based on delta magnitude and sample size, (4) emits structured annotations consumed by the eval dashboard for follow-up triage. This PR also includes a small test harness for synthetic strata and guidance docs for adding new strata definitions in repo. Checklist: add unit tests, integration smoke in CI, docs, add Linear ticket reference, update changelog. Related Linear: ENG-12044. This description is intentionally consolidated into a single continuous field for the PR artifact.

diff_snippets:
--- a/eval_harness/hooks/stratified_semantic_comparator.py
+++ b/eval_harness/hooks/stratified_semantic_comparator.py
@@ def compute_delta(baseline, current):
-    # previous coarse comparator
-    return simple_mean_diff(baseline, current)
+    # stratified comparator: compute per-cluster deltas and weight by cluster mass
+    deltas = [cluster_delta(b, c) for b, c in zip(baseline.clusters, current.clusters)]
+    weights = [max(1, c.count) for c in current.clusters]
+    return weighted_sum(deltas, weights)

--- a/ci/pipeline/eval_comparator_stage.yml
+++ b/ci/pipeline/eval_comparator_stage.yml
@@
-  - name: run-eval-gates
-    script: run_eval_gates.sh
+  - name: run-stratified-semantic-comparator
+    script: python -m eval_harness.ci.hooks.stratified_comparator_runner --config ci/configs/stratified_comparator.yml
testing_notes: Unit tests cover semantic clustering determinism with fixed seed, cluster persistence, and weighted delta logic. Integration smoke verifies the CI stage runs under 90s on standard runner with default downsample. Synthetic E2E validates quarantine escalation path using a seeded failure injection.
release_notes: Added stratified semantic comparator CI hook: enables per-stratum regression detection and progressive quarantine policy. Configurable downsample and minimum sample safeguards. Requires dashboard annotation consumer to be available to fully leverage quarantine workflow.
notes_for_ops: When enabling this hook in org CI, start with 'warn-only' mode for 2 weeks and monitor quarantine annotations in the eval dashboard. Recommended defaults: n_sample=500, min_sample=50, warn_delta=0.08, quarantine_delta=0.18. If running on limited CI machines, set downsample=200 to reduce memory footprint.
